notes.title: UPDATE v0.1.2.0 AVAILABLE NOW – NEW EBOLA DISEASE ADDED AND MORE! PLUS, GET QUARANTINE 34% OFF FOR A LIMITED TIME
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27451397/55050f5ca0ce98a369100d43b1bd517bf1781e0d.jpg

Hello Directors! Update v0.1.2.0 is OUT NOW. We’ve introduced an ALL-NEW Ebola disease scenario, operative and event improvements and more! See below for more details. Download today and get to work.

Have you been holding out from taking the Director’s chair? Jump in now and save! Quarantine is 34% off for a limited time. With all new content and improvements, the time is NOW to take on outbreaks across the globe and save humanity!

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27451397/7fe4b4e51198f515d4506455489c79fef833d114.png

Added New Disease Scenario – Ebola!
o        Minimize fatalities across the globe as this real-world outbreak gains momentum and begins to spread in Africa
          - New events
          - Special starting conditions
          - New map layout   

New Operative Movement
o        Many players suggested this change, and we agree! Operatives must now travel from city to city using movement points.
o        Overall this should make operative & disease locations much more important, and add a new layer of strategy.
o        To use an operative, first select an operative, then the target city (within range), then the operation.

Enhanced Events
o        Lots of balance changes
o        Event response options now show positive and negative effects. This should give you much better information before making a decision.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27451397/83b3ff4e7af26af4d88c643355088d44b06364f1.png

Improved Disease Visualization
o        The new visualization shows:
          - The origin city (“FROM”) and destination city (“TO”) during a disease spread action
          - Attacks on quarantine zones
          - General graphical improvements

New End of Turn Reminders
o        At the end of the turn, you’ll be reminded if you still need to:
         - Start a tech research
         - Start a lab research (if you have enough samples)
         - Give orders to idle operatives

notes.title: Quarantine Update v0.1.1.0 Now Available
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27451397/028ccc4e20740f6ef3fe6ee19cab6ff75082eae8.png

Directors Mobilize! We are pleased to announce that our first update for Quarantine is now available. Update  v0.1.1.0 contains a number of new additions outlined below. Also, in case you missed it, we have already pushed a few bug fixes and a tuning update that increased the difficulty level on ‘hard’ mode for all 3 scenarios.

NEW ADDITIONS:

•        IMPROVED DISEASE INFORMATION: The disease infection bar now has a tooltip that reveals exactly how many ‘spread’ and ‘intensify’ actions the disease has each turn, as well as the chance of spawning a negative situation. This information should help you understand the disease’s behavior and plan your strategy accordingly.
•        DISEASE MUTATION BAR: We’ve also added a mutation bar that shows when the disease is investing in mutating – and how close it is. This should help clarify how this mechanic works, and allow you to respond.
•        RESEARCH NOTIFICATIONS: When you complete disease or tech research, the game now notifies you much more clearly so you can select new research. Many players requested this – thank you for the suggestion, keep them coming!
•        ACHIEVEMENTS: We've added 3 new achievements inspired by community suggestions! What other achievements do you want to see in-game? Let us know and you might just see it added on the next update!
                 * Careless: Win all 3 scenarios without using the ""Heal Operative"" operation on hard difficulty. Thanks to Sniper___Prime for the idea.
                 * Dynamic Duo: Win all 3 scenarios by hiring only 1 additional operative on at least medium difficulty. Thanks to Sniper___Prime for the idea.
                 * Headstart: Win all 3 scenarios after not treating nor quarantining for the first 4 turns on hard difficulty. Thanks to Sniper___Prime for the idea.

We will continue to push more robust updates in the coming months and are working on incorporating your feedback. Thanks again for all of your support and again, keep the suggestions coming!

notes.title: Quarantine Tuning & Bug Fix Update
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27451397/8620d436c3ea1109e9b497b8f5d6c7e600b01f70.jpg

We’ve made some bug fixes and updates to game tuning. Please see full list below and don’t forget to report any additional technical issues or EA suggestions in our sub-forum. Thanks for your continued support! 

1.        The stability of the tutorial was improved
2.        Adjusting the Windows 10 text scaling doesn’t negatively affect the game resolution anymore
3.        The correct sample information is now shown when an operative levels up (thanks to zazyman32 for using the new mailbox to report this bug) 
4.        The “End Turn” button is now disabled as long the event window is shown
5.        Rebalanced tech tree to even out strengths of all sub-trees
6.        Increased the difficulty on hard on all 3 scenarios

notes.title: Bug Fixes Deployed
notes.notes:
Hello Quarantine community! It’s been a short while since the game launched and we are happy to see all of you already getting in and giving feedback. We are happy to announce that a Bug Fix has been pushed that will address the following issues:

·         All achievements should work now, including these listed below:
Intern 
Doctor 
Savior 
Globetrotter 
Jack of all trades 
Speedrun 

·  We removed all hardcoded local texts and fixed some Chinese and Russian errors.

·  Operations don’t change sorting anymore when upgrading them via tech.

- The chosen operative doesn’t change anymore when you choose a different operation.

Thank you!
